text: The prevalence of hyperemesis gravidarum among pregnant women in Ethiopia is high. Targeting pregnant women in the first trimester, with a previous history of hyperemesis gravidarum, and those with Helicobacter pylori infection during prenatal counseling on how to manage and reduce hyperemesis gravidarum is very helpful to avert related complications.
source_label: Prevalence and determinants of hyperemesis gravidarum among pregnant women in Ethiopia: A systematic review and meta-analysis
